main_text.p: Sed tamen audiri gemitus, vocéfque minantis Dæmonibus, nixtaq; preces, nulloque rogante Interdum responsa darı: nunc tollere vultus In cœlum, nunc figere humi, nunc plangere pectus Langius, & facra templum conspergere lympha, Donec auis lucis pranuncia spectra moneret Cedere, & in veterem se denuò condere nidum.

Tum templo egressi, dicenda tacenda referre Langius, umbrarum poenas, flammaque rapidàm vim Lustralis: quot carnifices cacodæmones ollas Admoueant, veruibus quot figant, fluctibus umbras Quot mersent gelidis, quot Missis eulque lenetur Poena, velut ciuis Stygio vixisset Auerno, Ordine cuncta recensebat: neque credula deerat Turba hominis purgatricis rediuiua fauillæ Gloria crefcebat, multùm indignante Luthero: Et creuisset adhuc, nisi vel formidine capius, Vel pretio vitius, vel vino rusticus ille Anormis comes, Exorcissmi proditor ebeu, Cunctla reuelasset taciti mendacia facri, Exillo fluere, & retro sublapsa referri Spes prada, & nimium vinacis gloria veri Crefcere. Quapropter moneo debinc fingite parce Somnia, noctiurnos lemures, miracula, ni fors Aut apud extremos fieri dicantur Iberos, Americófve, aut ⁊Ethiopas; calidóve sub axe, Et caput ignotis vbi Nilus condit arenis, Vnde aderit nemo, qui testis dictla refutet. Forsitan externos solertia fugerit hostes Callida, sed pestem natam intra viscera, & ipsis Herentem venis hominum vix vlla caucebit Cura, nisi nostros vis prouida numinis olim

page.notes: Transcription of the Latin is from a worn scan; several words (notably in the marginal reference marks and the ligature "ⱥ/Æ" and the Greek-like letter in "Ethiopas") are uncertain. The lower signature "C" is a gathering mark. Marginal reference marks at the page edges carry no legible text and are not transcribed. Long s rendered as s; u/v and i/j normalised.
